items.description: Fathy Abdirahaman popularly known to her online followers as ‘Tushta died on the spot on Monday after plunging from the seventh floor of Tsavo Sunset 2 Apartments in Thindigua.
items.imageCaption: Fathy Abdirahaman popularly known to her online followers as ‘Tushta’ died on the spot on Monday after plunging from the seventh floor of Tsavo Sunset 2 Apartments in Thindigua. [Courtesy]
items.author: Fidelis Kabunyi
items.excerpt: Police in Kiambu County have launched investigation into the death of a 23-year-old social media content creator who died after falling from a high-rise residential building along Kiambu Road. The deceased, identified as Fathy Abdirahaman popularly known to her online followers as ‘Tushta’ died on the spot on Monday after plunging from the seventh floor of Tsavo Sunset 2 Apartments in Thindigua.
